team’s cell and reject moves onto another team’s port, using the surrounding
occupied-cell check consistently.

FileAccess.store_string() and the subsequent flush operation before renaming
temporary_path; on either failure, capture the relevant file error, remove the
temporary file, and return that error without calling
DirAccess.rename_absolute().
